title: Senior Manager Finance
jobDescription:
As Senior Manager
- Finance, you will be expected to manage the Financial Controlling of the Company & assist in commercial finance areas such as forecasting, budgeting, cost reduction analysis, and reviewing operational performance. This role will grow to Financial Controller role in 1 to 2 years, depending on candidates performance. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Delhi Area (MG Road, Near Gurgaon Border) for a Senior Manager
- Finance. The Senior Manager will oversee and lead financial controlling, accounting and financial analysis. Duties and

Managing all the required financial compliances related to GST, TDS & other statutory requirements. Working on new projects covering various financial aspects Handle banking relationships and finding improvement opportunities Oversee the External /Internal Audit, review and analyze results Ensure the compliance/documentation requirement for all laws like Companies Act, Income Tax Act, GST. Company Description: Industry Buying is India’s leading B2B product ecommerce platform, jointly owned by Monota RO (Japan’s largest B2B e-commerce company), W.W. Grainger (the world’s largest industrial e-commerce enterprise), and India Mart. Serving over 1.5 million business customers across India. the platform offers a vast catalog of high-quality industrial and agricultural products across 40+ categories, including Office supplies, Safety, Tools and more. Committed to providing a seamless shopping experience, Industry Buying delivers products to every pin code in India with secure payment options and reliable delivery. Dedicated to fostering a thriving online trade ecosystem, Industry Buying connects buyers and sellers to drive growth and efficiency in the B2B marketplace.

title: Category Owner - June
jobDescription: Industrybuying is looking for a highly motivated and focused Category Owner to lead the growth and profitability of a product category. The role will be responsible for developing category strategy, driving revenue growth, expanding product assortment, strengthening vendor partnerships, and ensuring a superior customer experience. This position requires a strong blend of business acumen, analytical capability, and stakeholder management skills to scale the category in a competitive B2B e-commerce environment. Key Responsibilities Fulfilment & Supply Chain Coordination Work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, and Fulfilment teams to improve internal & external customer service levels and order fulfilment rates. Category Growth & Revenue Management Own the P&L and overall performance of the assigned category. Drive category revenue, margin, and market share through strategic initiatives. Identify growth opportunities and execute plans to increase sales of both existing and newly launched SKUs. Assortment & Portfolio Management Expand the category by onboarding new brands, vendors, and products. Optimize product assortment to ensure breadth, depth, and relevance for customers. Drive SKU rationalization and portfolio enhancement based on demand trends and business priorities. Ensure product content, specifications, and merchandising are optimized for conversion. Vendor & Brand Management Build and maintain strong relationships with manufacturers, distributors, and key suppliers. Lead commercial negotiations related to pricing, margins, rebates, promotional support, and business terms. Identify and onboard new brands to strengthen the category portfolio. Pricing & Competitive Intelligence Establish competitive pricing strategies while maintaining category profitability. Monitor market trends, competitor pricing, and customer demand patterns. Drive pricing optimization through data-driven decision making and vendor negotiations. Analytics & Business Insights Leverage data and analytics to identify business opportunities, customer trends, and category performance gaps. Track key performance indicators including revenue, margin, assortment growth, fulfilment metrics, and inventory turns. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related field. 3–8 years of experience in Category Management, Product Management, Procurement, Sourcing, Vendor Management, or Business Development. AI-savvy with a keen interest in leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and drive data-backed decision-making. Strong commercial acumen with experience managing category growth and vendor partnerships. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and drive business decisions. Proven negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities. Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Experience in B2B e-commerce, industrial distribution, procurement, or MRO products will be preferred. Preferred Category Experience Candidates with experience in any of the following categories will be preferred: Material Handling & Packing Pumps & Motors Industrial Supplies & MRO

title: Online Sales Executive
jobDescription:
Industrybuying.com is one of India's leading B2B e-commerce platforms, serving businesses across a wide range of industrial and commercial categories. We are looking for enthusiastic Telesales Professionals who are passionate about sales and customer engagement, and can drive business growth through telephonic and online sales channels. In addition to a competitive fixed salary, this role offers attractive performance-based incentives, providing excellent earning potential. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are also encouraged to apply. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Handle inbound and outbound sales calls and convert inquiries into successful sales. • Build and nurture relationships with prospective customers to drive revenue growth. • Identify and convert high-value sales opportunities. • Retain existing customers and encourage repeat business. • Manage customer accounts, sales pipelines, and follow-ups effectively. • Maintain accurate customer records, call reports, quotations, and correspondence in the CRM system. • Develop and execute plans to consistently achieve sales targets. Desired Candidate Profile: • Graduate in any discipline; Engineering graduates will be preferred. • Prior experience in telesales, telemarketing, inside sales, or online sales is an advantage. Freshers may also apply. • Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills. • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and online business processes will be an added advantage.

title: Category Group Head - June
jobDescription: Industrybuying is looking for a highly motivated and focused Category Group Head to lead and scale a portfolio of product categories. The role will be responsible for driving category growth, profitability, assortment expansion, vendor partnerships, pricing strategy, and operational excellence across multiple categories. As a business leader, the Category Group Head will own the overall P&L of the assigned category group, lead a team of Category Owners, and work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Finance to achieve business objectives. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen, leadership capability, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills to drive sustainable growth in a dynamic B2B e-commerce environment. Key Responsibilities Business & P&L Leadership Own the P&L, growth strategy, and overall performance of a portfolio of categories. Drive revenue, margin, market share, and profitability across the category group. Develop and execute short-term and long-term category growth plans aligned with organizational objectives. Identify new business opportunities, emerging product segments, and market expansion initiatives. Team Leadership & Capability Building Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Category Owners to drive category performance and business outcomes. Establish category goals, monitor performance, and ensure achievement of key business metrics. Build a high-performance culture through coaching, guidance, and continuous capability development. Category Strategy & Portfolio Management Define assortment strategy and portfolio expansion plans across categories. Drive onboarding of new brands, suppliers, and product lines to strengthen category competitiveness. Ensure optimal product mix, inventory planning, and lifecycle management across categories. Oversee category merchandising and customer experience initiatives to maximize conversion and growth. Vendor & Strategic Partnership Management Build and maintain strategic relationships with key manufacturers, distributors, and supplier partners. Lead commercial negotiations related to pricing, margins, rebates, promotional investments, and strategic partnerships. Drive joint business planning initiatives with key vendors to accelerate category growth. Pricing & Market Competitiveness Establish category pricing strategies to balance competitiveness, growth, and profitability. Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, customer demand, and industry developments. Drive data-led pricing and assortment decisions to maximize market share and margins. Operational Excellence & Supply Chain Collaboration Drive inventory optimization, demand forecasting, and working capital efficiency across categories. Ensure seamless execution of category initiatives through strong cross-functional collaboration. Analytics & Business Insights Leverage data analytics to identify growth opportunities, profitability levers, and operational improvements. Review category performance metrics, sales trends, margins, fulfilment KPIs, and inventory health. Present business reviews, strategic recommendations, and performance updates to senior leadership. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related field. MBA preferred. 8–15 years of experience in Category Management, Business Management, Procurement, Product Management, Sourcing, or related commercial roles. Knowledge & experience of using AI tools for Category, will be a plus. Proven experience managing multiple categories and leading category, sourcing, or business teams. Strong P&L management experience with a track record of delivering revenue and profitability growth. Excellent commercial negotiation, vendor management, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate data into business actions. Effective people leadership experience with a demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams. Experience in B2B e-commerce, industrial distribution, procurement, manufacturing, or MRO-focused organizations will be highly preferred. Preferred Industry Experience Industrial Supplies & MRO Electrical, Industrial Automation, LED & Lighting, Solar, Furniture
